text:
Priya (CSM): Hey team — acme is going live next Tue. Can we draft a 1-page customer-facing runbook (bulleted) that covers cache priming, safe batching windows, streaming fallback, quick health checks, and a short renewal-risk signal checklist? Need something the customer success rep can paste into a kickoff email.

Ava (CS Ops): Yep. I can sketch it. Keep it super action-oriented. :white_check_mark:

Liam (SRE): Quick note: for low-latency customers we recommend batch_window <= 20ms for interactive flows, 50-200ms is OK for throughput jobs. Also include fallback to single-token streaming when queue depth > X.

Jorge (Solutions Eng): I'll add a tiny config snippet for their infra team.

Priya (CSM): Prefer short checklist sections: Preflight, Go-live hour, Degradation plan, Renewal signals, Feedback capture. One line each.

Ava (CS Ops): Draft below — can we confirm wording?

Ava (CS Ops): PRE-FLIGHT (2 days before)
- Validate API keys + role scopes with customer
- Run smoke: 10 warm requests to pin cold-starts
- Seed cache with top-20 prompt prefixes (customer-provided)
- Confirm model pin/version and quant profile

Ava (CS Ops): GO-LIVE HOUR
- Set batching policy: interactive routes -> max_wait_ms: 20, max_tokens_per_batch: 1024
- Set background routes -> max_wait_ms: 150, max_tokens_per_batch: 8192
- Enable prefix/KV caching for repeat prompts
- Start 15m warm pool: pre-init 50 concurrent lightweight requests

Ava (CS Ops): HEALTH CHECKS (every 5m)
- Latency P95 < SLA threshold
- Error rate < 1%
- Token throughput within expected range
- If latency spiking: toggle to lower-capacity model or reduce batch window

Ava (CS Ops): DEGRADATION & FALLBACK
- If queue depth > 200 -> auto-fallback: streaming single-token flush + reduce max_wait_ms
- If model OOMs or GPU failures -> route to next-compatible variant (quantized)
- Communication: status channel + customer notify template (1 sentence)

Ava (CS Ops): RENEWAL SIGNALS (early indicators)
- Usage drops > 30% week-over-week after onboarding
- Repeated timeouts or repeated quality regressions flagged in support tickets
- No engagement with enablement resources after 2 weeks
- Flag for CSM outreach and possible dev check-in

Ava (CS Ops): FEEDBACK CAPTURE (easy for customer)
- Short daily form link + 3 quick questions (latency, accuracy, UX)
- Automated eval: sample prompt set every 12 hours, post results to shared dashboard
- One-line CS template to ask for examples when quality drops

Jorge (Solutions Eng): Config snippet for customer infra (paste into their repo):
```yaml
routes:
  - name: interactive
    max_wait_ms: 20
    max_tokens_per_batch: 1024
    caching: prefix
  - name: background
    max_wait_ms: 150
    max_tokens_per_batch: 8192
    caching: none
fallbacks:
  - condition: queue_depth > 200
    action: enable_streaming_single_token
  - condition: gpu_failure
    action: route_to: model-quant-v2
```

Liam (SRE): Add this quick healthcheck curl they can run:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"health-check","route":"interactive"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
- Expect 200 + latency header

Priya (CSM): This is great. Can we also include 2 escalation contacts and short owner lines?

Ava (CS Ops): Escalation owners:
- Tier 1: Priya (CSM) — customer communication
- Tier 2: Jorge (Solutions Eng) — infra/config questions
- Tier 3: Liam (SRE) — incidents & routing

Ava (CS Ops): Owner action items (short):
- Priya: send runbook to customer + collect seed prompts by EOD Thu
- Jorge: share config snippet to repo + confirm model pin by Fri
- Liam: schedule 30m preflight run at Mon 10:00am

Priya (CSM): I'll send it. One more ask: capture a simple feedback checkbox that maps to renewal signals "would recommend / neutral / not recommend" — will that work?

Ava (CS Ops): Yes. Also add an automated eval alert: if accuracy metric drops > 8% vs baseline -> open ticket tagged renewal-risk.

OnboardBot: Deployment notice: acme-infra staged to prod at 2305123460 — warm pool initialized. :rocket:

Priya (CSM): Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll paste into the kickoff email and follow up after first 24h. :raised_hands:
